name: browser-workbench
description: Browser inspection, testing, and opt-in Windows screenshot import for Codex on Linux and WSL.

interface.shortDescription: Browser inspection and opt-in WSL screenshot import.
interface.longDescription: Browser Workbench for Codex provides a pinned Playwright MCP server for browser inspection, testing, and controlled interaction on Linux and WSL, plus an explicit Windows-to-WSL screenshot bridge with private local storage.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this page with an accessibility snapshot and relevant console errors.
Test the local app in an isolated headless Playwright browser and report failures.
Import my Windows clipboard screenshot into WSL and inspect it.
